rollups.text: Music interests and activities: the user said they had recently been listening to indie-folk and prefers acoustic, vocal-centric music with strong lyrics and storytelling, especially Phoebe Bridgers and Julien Baker (2023-02-28); listens to NPR’s “All Songs Considered” and asked for music-related podcasts (2023-02-28); was considering learning guitar (2023-02-28); later said they played guitar frequently and used a digital piano for gigs at small venues and private events (2023-02-28).

Collectibles and collecting: the user sought a rare vintage typewriter (2023-02-28), a rare vintage camera (2023-02-28), and a 1950s Omega Seamaster reference 2913 (2023-02-28). The user collects Spider-Man comics and figurines, follows Spider-Verse, is a fan of Miles Morales and owns several variant covers; they protect and organize comics with bags, boards, top-loaders, and binders (dates not specified). A display case has sections for Spider-Man, Lord of the Rings, Prince of Persia, and vintage Star Wars items; the user added a Spider-Man Funko Pop and obtained the final issue they needed for a Spider-Man run (2023-02-28).

Birding and conservation interests: the user attended a guided bird walk at a local park led by Mark, where the group saw 25 species (2023-02-28); wanted to learn bird songs and calls, asked about feeder visitors and deterring squirrels and raccoons, and considered a shorebird outing to a nearby nature reserve (2023-02-28). On an undated visit, the user saw a pair of American Golden-Plovers for the first time and admired their foraging and display. The user also attended a local Audubon society lecture on migration challenges and conservation, expressed concern about threats to birds, and considered joining local birding initiatives (before and on 2023-02-28).

Language-learning activities: the user had daily conversations in Spanish with their abuela for three months and felt they were improving (2023-02-28); listened to French podcasts during the daily commute and described themself as an intermediate French learner (2023-02-28); considered attending a local language-exchange group and starting a language-learning journal (2023-02-28).

Cooking and gardening interests: the user planned brunch featuring heirloom tomatoes and especially liked grilled-peach and tomato salad (2023-02-28); considered coffee cake with crumb topping and liked cinnamon-raisin French toast (2023-02-28); was excited to try Korean and Indian cooking, use an Instant Pot, and experiment with spices (2023-02-28). The user hoped to start a garden with basil, rosemary, and thyme, followed by tomatoes, cucumbers, and carrots, and considered companion planting (2023-02-28).

Melbourne job search and communication-skill improvement: the user had a first interview at a local restaurant and was not hired; the interviewer advised improving communication skills (2023-02-28). The user planned to practice using online resources and exercises. They sought entry-level, preferably part-time food-industry work around central Melbourne, ideally about 20 hours weekly, preferring morning or afternoon shifts and not evenings or weekends; kitchen assistant or dishwasher roles were of particular interest (2023-02-28). The user planned to apply for a few opportunities and keep initial application materials concise and positive, saving discussion of the prior interview for a later interview (2023-02-28).

Search for an Omega Seamaster reference 2913: the user identified a specific 1950s model they wanted (2023-02-28). They planned to contact Bob’s Watches and Matthew Bain, set listing alerts on 1stdibs and Chrono24, and post wanted ads on the Vintage Omega Collectors forum and Omega Forums (2023-02-28). No purchase or later outcome is recorded.

Persistent cough and pneumonia: the user saw primary care physician Dr. Smith on 2023-02-10 after a cough had lasted three weeks; Dr. Smith diagnosed bronchitis and prescribed antibiotics. The user finished the antibiotics on 2023-02-20, but the cough persisted; a follow-up with Dr. Smith was planned for 2023-03-01. The user later reported seeing pulmonologist Dr. Johnson on 2023-03-10; a chest X-ray showed pneumonia. On 2023-02-28, the user separately said they were still taking antibiotics for pneumonia and expected to finish soon. The records do not reconcile the differing antibiotic timelines.

Digestive symptoms and dairy: by 2023-02-28, the user had kept a food diary for about a month, recording meals, times, and symptoms. They reported bloating and gassiness around 7–8 out of 10 and mostly morning abdominal pain; dairy seemed to worsen symptoms after the user had eaten more than usual. The user planned to reduce dairy while waiting for a gastroenterology appointment with Dr. Patel scheduled for 2023-04-15. The user also reported noticing dairy-related bloating and gas and trying to limit dairy (2023-02-28).

Daily step-count change and goal: the user’s average increased from about 6,000–7,000 steps a day a few months earlier to about 8,000–9,000 steps (2023-02-28), with the user attributing increased activity to a new job. The user’s target was 10,000–11,000 steps daily, and they found splitting the target into 5,000 by lunchtime and another 5,000–6,000 in the afternoon more achievable. The user agreed to weekly Friday reviews.
